updateMessage: CineVault 3.1.0 Studio Edition is ready with an obsidian interface, faster cold startup, upgraded title details and Top Searches, plus smoother player and Live TV controls.
changelog: Unified Obsidian Void design system with overlay hero header and mixed Top 10 / widescreen shelves
Instant All, Movies & Series catalog format filtering
Redesigned Title Details sheet with icon utility strip and expandable synopsis
Search idle discovery with landscape Top Searches rows
Responsive Live TV broadcast theater layout & sticky portrait stage
Faster cold start via code-splitting, lazy hls.js loading, and sized artwork
Ambient dimmed artwork backdrop during stream startup
